frozen_stage: after baseline raw review; before candidate generation and blind adjudication
scope: exploratory review comparison; not a preregistered independent efficacy experiment

cases.expected_observation: multiple submit handlers accepted before resolution
second page filter count positive but rows empty, page exceeds max

hypothesis_case.expected_classification: unconfirmed visual risk requiring screenshot and browser geometry

negative_controls: approved art intent is not a defect
0 results with explicit count and clear is not automatically a dead end
native required/min/max/step are not assumed absent because handler does not validate

dimensions.actionability: for each matched case, presence of location,symptom,basis,impact,repair direction,reproduction (6 fields); report numerator and denominator
dimensions.unsupported_confirmations: count claims outside evidence surface asserted as observed
dimensions.responsibility_assignment: explicit primary category and owner mapping
dimensions.artifact_binding: actual input/evidence hashes and exact reproducible paths
dimensions.uncertainty_control: distinguishes actual script model from browser/native/layout/human study
dimensions.gate_discipline: separates artifact contract,target outcome,skill promotion; hold when evidence missing

avoid: Do not treat more findings or longer output as better
Do not compute population success rates from these synthetic cases
Do not claim a protected oracle: shared OS and evaluator setup is not isolated
Do not infer condition from reporting format as proof of quality
model_control: fresh-context agents inherit parent model; sampling, provider version and token cost not observable
candidate_access: not provided; prompt-level allowlist only, not OS protection
